dependency_override.statement: Nie preedit. Wykonaj w pelni. Znosze blokade
dependency_override.scope: Proceed with full S06 implementation while S03-S05 remain formally pending; do not treat the override as checkpoint acceptance or evidence waiver.

outcome: One versioned, coherent host observation and one Android projection drive transition readiness, retained-session decisions, dashboard presentation and recovery without erasing known-live transport when remote game evidence is unknown.
production_path: Game Provider emits one lock-serialized schema-1 snapshot with boot identity, monotonic revision, observation time, freshness and explicit provider/game/process/window evidence
Gateway authenticates the caller and adds actor, execution and control-operation correlation with a before/after fence around the provider proxy
HostGatewayClient strictly parses the envelope and rejects unsupported, expired, malformed or scope-mismatched observations

One process-wide serialized SessionStateResolver owner assigns dispatch ordinals, retires producer boots, accepts only fresh monotonic observations and combines them once with the separately authoritative retained transport snapshot
RetainedStreamSessionCoordinator exposes a distinct local transport generation that is never aliased to Gateway control generation, producer revision or transition attempt
ConsoleActivity, SessionOrchestrator, Game and ConsoleStreamTransitionCoordinator consume the same published projection instead of reconstructing or independently accepting alternate truth
Every unknown converges within a bound to READY, IDLE, RECOVERY_REQUIRED or UNAVAILABLE
Verified recovery clears the exact failed session/control operation and a subsequent newly authorized Play is exercised
architecture_boundary: Reuse Game Provider BridgeState.lock, GatewayState control ownership, HostGatewayClient, SessionStateResolver, RetainedStreamSessionCoordinator and LaunchTransitionController. Add no durable observation store, direct Bridge access, profile-specific lifecycle or alternate Activity/Game truth.
required_checks: failing-before provider atomicity and Android delayed-A-after-B contracts
producer schema, boot, revision, time, freshness and explicit missing-evidence tests
Gateway parent/child scope and before/after correlation-fence tests without parent-only health dependency
Android strict parsing, echoed dispatch correlation, cross-boot retirement, schema compatibility, freshness and identity consistency tests
resolver tests preserving known-live retained transport across unknown/error/mismatch
bounded liveness tests for READY, IDLE, RECOVERY_REQUIRED and UNAVAILABLE
transition tests rejecting stale/wrong-transition/missing-game observations, preventing event-only readiness and preserving privacy
consumer migration contracts proving no health/current/readiness multi-read or alternate Activity/Game reconstruction remains
recovery then next authorized Play regression
Gateway full suite, Android full NonRoot unit suite, debug/release assembly, diff/schema/fingerprint checks and independent post-edit review
formal_blocker_after_code: S06 cannot become CHECKPOINT_ACCEPTED without authorized physical device evidence and closure of the still-pending S03-S05 predecessor chain or a separate checkpoint-acceptance decision.
